p0.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 160 mm double spiral mixing paddle on a 600 mm shaft, with an M14 thread for hand mixers. It is the big paddle for deep buckets and full bag mixes: the 160 mm head turns over a lot of material each revolution and the long shaft keeps the mixer clear of the bucket rim, so leveller and grout mix right to the bottom.

Fits

  • BAT Pro 1050 W and 1600 W hand mixers
  • Any other M14 thread drill mixer

Use it for

  • Self leveller, grout, paint and other fluid compounds in large or deep buckets
  • Full bag batches

Specifications

  • Head diameter: 160 mm
  • Length: 600 mm
  • Thread: M14
  • Reinforced double spiral, galvanised steel
  • Raimondi lists its 160 mm double spiral paddle as Art. 178 389L

Good to know

  • A 160 mm head is best on a 1600 W class mixer. It will labour a small drill in stiff material.
  • Mix fluid products at low speed so you do not whip air in.
  • Rinse the spiral straight after mixing.

p1.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi whisk style mixing paddle with a 120 mm four blade head and a hex shaft for a standard drill chuck. It is the paddle for mixing grout, paint and small batches of adhesive with an ordinary drill, no M14 mixer needed, and the open blade design blends liquids without climbing the bucket.

Fits

  • Standard drill chucks (10 mm hex shaft)
  • Not for M14 thread mixers

Use it for

  • Mixing grout, paint, primers and small adhesive batches with a drill
  • Buckets up to about 15 litres

Specifications

  • Head: 120 mm, four blades
  • Shaft: 10 mm hex, for chuck fitting
  • Galvanised steel
  • Raimondi lists its 120 mm four blade hex shank paddle as Art. 178

Good to know

  • Tighten the chuck well and run the drill at low speed. A paddle spinning fast in a drill flicks grout everywhere.
  • For a 140 mm head on an M14 mixer, the whisk style M14 version is listed separately.
  • Rinse the paddle straight after mixing.

p2.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi whisk style mixing paddle with a wide 140 mm four blade head and an M14 thread for hand mixers. The four shaped blades cut through thinset and adhesive as well as grout and paint, so it is the general purpose paddle to leave on the mixer when you are switching between products through the day.

Fits

  • BAT Pro 1050 W and 1600 W hand mixers
  • Any other M14 thread drill mixer

Use it for

  • Tile adhesive and thinset
  • Grout, ready render, primers and paint

Specifications

  • Head: 140 mm, four blades
  • Thread: M14
  • Galvanised steel
  • Raimondi lists its 140 mm four blade M14 paddle as Art. 178 389E

Good to know

  • Use low speed for grout and leveller so you do not whip air in, and the higher speed for stiff adhesive.
  • For fluid products in deep buckets the spiral paddles lift material better from the bottom.
  • Rinse the paddle straight after mixing so adhesive does not set on the blades.

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi bucket with steel handle is a site bucket built to be mixed in, kicked, dropped and left in the sun. The 4 mm thick shockproof plastic and reinforced base and rim stand up to a paddle mixer and to carrying rubble, and the steel handle will not pull out of the sides the way a plastic bail does. Choose 27 or 45 litres.

Use it for

  • Mixing adhesive, grout and leveller with a hand mixer
  • Carrying water, sand and site waste

Features

  • 4 mm thick shockproof plastic
  • Reinforced base and rim
  • Steel carry handle
  • Rated for use down to minus 5 degrees C

Specifications

  • 27 litre: Raimondi Art. 289CICO
  • 45 litre: Raimondi Art. 289CMAN
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • The 45 litre size takes a full 20 kg bag of adhesive with room to mix.
  • Rinse it out before the mix sets. A build up of old adhesive in the bottom contaminates the next batch.
  • Raimondi also makes a 45 litre bucket with moulded handles for the Iperbet mixer.

p4.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi e-Fox is a cordless vibrator for laying large format tiles and slabs. Run it over the tile after you set it and the high frequency vibration drives the air out from under the slab, collapses the trowel ridges and gives full adhesive coverage, so there are no hollow spots to crack later. It also bonds uncoupling and waterproofing membranes to the floor.

Use it for

  • Bedding large format porcelain and slabs on floors and walls

Features

  • 21 x 41 cm vibrating surface, reducible to 15 x 15 cm for precise work
  • 3 handles: two outer for two handed use, one central for one handed
  • PVC vibrating plate slides easily on the tile and transmits the full vibration
  • Covers 150 to 200 m2 per battery charge

Specifications

  • Battery: 15 V, 38.5 Wh lithium ion, rated for more than 100,000 m2 before performance drops
  • Motor speed: 3500 rpm
  • Weight: 5.8 kg
  • Model: 321BATPRR
  • Made in Italy

What's in the box

  • Padded protective bag with handles and shoulder strap

Good to know

  • A spare battery is listed separately so the e-Fox never stops mid floor.

p5.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Lupetto is the compact tile vibrator for laying tiles on a mortar (mud) bed. Set the tile on the bed, run the Lupetto over it, and the 8200 vibrations a minute level the tile and drive the mud into full contact with the back of it, so the floor comes up flat and solid without tapping every tile by hand. At 11 kg it is the one person machine in Raimondi's vibrator range.

Use it for

  • Laying floor tiles on a sand and cement mud bed using the vibration method

Features

  • Speed selector: 6000 or 8200 rpm
  • Interchangeable rectangular plastic plate, 25 x 45 cm
  • Ergonomic handle
  • Runs on a safe 42 V supply from the included transformer

Specifications

  • Vibrating plate: 25 x 45 cm
  • Motor: 150 W, 230 V to 42 V
  • Weight: 11.2 kg
  • Model: 116CC
  • Made in Italy

What's in the box

  • Lupetto with flat plate and 230 V to 42 V transformer

Good to know

  • The optional 33 roller plate (Art. 200LU01A) turns it into a rolling vibrator for larger floors. Spare flat plates are also available.

p6.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Mastino is a roller vibrator for laying tiles on a mortar (mud) bed. You wheel it across the freshly set tiles and the rollers vibrate each one down into the mud, levelling the floor and bonding the bed to the back of the tile in one pass. It is the step up from the Terranova, with a top speed of 10,000 vibrations a minute for faster bedding on big floors.

Use it for

  • Laying floor tiles on a sand and cement mud bed using the vibration method

Features

  • Three vibration speeds: 5000, 7000 and 10000 rpm
  • Telescopic handle and steel roller holder
  • Includes 36 rollers, 40 mm diameter
  • Runs on a safe 42 V supply through the included transformer

Specifications

  • Vibrating area: about 49 x 56 cm
  • Motor: 0.4 kW, 230 V to 42 V
  • Weight: about 56.5 kg
  • Model: 349
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Set the tiles with a small gap, run the Mastino over them, then check levels with a straight edge before the mud firms.
  • Hose mud off the rollers at the end of each day so they keep turning.

p7.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Terranova is a roller vibrator for laying tiles on a mortar (mud) bed. Wheel it over the freshly set tiles and 44 rollers vibrate them down into the mud at up to 8600 vibrations a minute, levelling the tiles and bonding the bed to the back of them in one pass. It covers a 47 x 52 cm area, so a run across the room beds a whole row.

Use it for

  • Laying floor tiles on a sand and cement mud bed using the vibration method

Features

  • Three vibration speeds: 4000, 6500 and 8600 rpm
  • Telescopic handle and steel roller holder
  • Includes 44 rollers, 40 mm diameter, in 11 rows of 4
  • Runs on a safe 42 V supply from the included transformer

Specifications

  • Vibrating area: 47 x 52 cm
  • Motor: 300 W, 230 V to 42 V
  • Weight: 47 kg
  • Model: 105
  • Made in Italy

What's in the box

  • Terranova with roller assembly and 230 V to 42 V transformer

Good to know

  • Spare 11 row roller assemblies and the 300 W / 42 V transformer are listed separately.
  • Hose mud off the rollers at the end of each day.
